WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity,
    AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity
  FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
  ia.invoice_number,
  ia.average_quantity,
  ia.average_cost_ratio,
  ia.average_quantity - oa.average_quantity AS quantity_above_average
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ia.average_quantity > oa.average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_above_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: `product_quantity` contains numeric text, so it is cast to a numeric value before averaging.
